// CASE swift_for_tuple_shadow expect=pass
func forTuple(_ plans: [(items: [Int], width: Int)]) async throws {
  let width = 1
  try await probe(width)
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for (items, width) in plans {
      group.addTask { try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save) }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}
// CASE swift_closure_shorthand_params expect=pass
func closureParams(_ plans: [Plan]) async throws {
  let width = 1
  try await probe(width)
  try await run(plans) { items, width in
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_tuple_let_inner expect=pass
func tupleLet(_ items: [Int], _ config: Config) async throws {
  let width = 1
  try await probe(width)
  do {
    let (width, retries) = config.parsed()
    _ = retries
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save)
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
